title: The second scout
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the narrow curved iron-and-stone catwalk with a rusted iron railing circling the brass lantern room at the top of a weathered cliffside stone lighthouse, high above a rocky ocean and sea spray. Time and weather: darkening storm at dusk, cold slate-blue light, rain, lightning on the horizon.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; small gunmetal-grey scout drones the size of seagulls, each with a single crimson optical visor and whirring rotors.
Camera: over Penny's shoulder at the incoming drone; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: A second scout dives at Penny; she angles her reflector and bounces a flash of lightning into its crimson sensor; the drone wobbles, blinded, and spirals harmlessly into the railing.
No dialogue.
Sound: lightning crack, flash zap, wobbling rotor, clang.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly with the same camera move, the same characters (Penny, scout drones), identical costumes and props, the same setting, lighting and weather.
Action: Penny lowers the reflector with a satisfied smirk.
No dialogue.
Sound continues: lightning crack, flash zap, wobbling rotor, clang.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
negative_prompt: text, captions, subtitles, watermark, logo, extra limbs, duplicated characters, sudden wardrobe changes, costume swaps, graphic injury, blood, gore, still image, slideshow, freeze frame, live action humans, 2D flat animation, anime, background music
